requirements.text: The system must allow for multiple file upload to be configured on a per-page basis.
The system must allow actors to organize their voice clips into a portfolio.
The system must allow actors to download their voice clips in a flexible format.
The system must store audio clips in a format conducive to speech.
The system must allow actors to delete recorded clips.
The system must allow web feeds to be turned on or off on a per-page basis.
An actor must be able to search through pages in a course.
The system must display a search box on every page after an actor has logged in.
A course administrator must be able to grade an assignment.
The system should display grade information to the appropriate actor.
The system should maintain a grade history.
The system must provide a wiki where actors can collaboratively create networks of documents.
The system must provide a blog engine.
The system must provide both e-mail and SMS notifications for pages.
As far as possible, the system should provide a simple, responsive interface.
The system must be backed up on a configurable schedule.
The system should be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The system should support at least 1000 concurrent users.
The system must be maintainable without substantial modification.
Relevant, online documentation for users should be available on each page.
System administrators must have access to comprehensive, searchable documentation.
The system must encrypt all stored audio clips at rest and enforce strict access control lists (ACLs) ensuring only the owner and authorized course administrators can access specific portfolio items.
The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure that grade information is only viewable by the student to whom it belongs and their assigned course administrators.
All system backups must be encrypted at rest and stored in a secure, access-controlled environment to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration.
The system must support at least 1000 concurrent active users with a 95th percentile response time of less than 2 seconds for standard page loads.
The system must maintain a maximum RTO of 6 hours and an RPO of 24 hours for all course data.
The system interface must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards and achieve a System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 70 or higher in user testing.
The system must be maintainable by a single administrator with no more than 4 hours of manual intervention per month for routine updates.
The system must render pages within 2 seconds under a load of 1000 concurrent users.
The system must support a storage quota of 500MB per user for audio portfolios, with a total system capacity of 5TB.
The search engine must return results for course-level queries in under 1 second for a dataset of up to 100,000 documents.

OPEN: The notification system requirement does not address the security of PII (Personally Identifiable Information) transmitted via SMS or email. - The system must not include sensitive student data (e.g., grades, full names, or specific assignment content) in SMS or email notifications, and must provide a secure opt-in mechanism for communication.

OPEN: The requirement for 99% uptime does not specify the measurement period or the definition of 'downtime' (e.g., does it include scheduled maintenance?). - The system shall maintain 99% availability, excluding pre-announced maintenance windows, measured on a rolling 30-day basis.

OPEN: The performance requirement for 1000 concurrent users lacks a definition of 'concurrent' (e.g., active sessions vs. requests per second) and expected throughput. - The system must support 1000 concurrent users with an average request latency of <500ms and a throughput of at least 50 requests per second.
